## Known biases

Williams: read on 2026-11-27 (F6) from the article PDF and Data S4 that Yuri downloaded (before that the publisher refused automated access); a New Zealand expert-elicitation study (46 experts, weighted mean of responses, not validated against observed damage), whose substation components are named by voltage tier without kV, equipment or datum; licence CC BY-NC-ND, so values are cited, not copied wholesale. Bor et al. is a preprint (manuscript submitted to Earth&\#x27;s Future), not peer reviewed, and Table 1 gives HV (&gt;345 kV, anchored) substations only; the flood parameters are taken from a literature synthesis (Kabre and Weimar 2022). Karagiannakis was read on an arXiv copy of the article, not the publisher page.
